upstream.subject: Fix handling very large stacks of sync middleware

surfaced.subject: Fix regression routing a large stack in a single route
surfaced.description: The new sync-recursion guard was placed after `var layer = stack[idx++]` in Route.prototype.dispatch, so when the 101st synchronous hop tripped the guard, idx had already advanced past the fetched layer and that handler was never invoked - every 101st route handler was silently skipped. Shipped in 4.18.0 and fixed in 4.18.2, so the regression reached released users.
